title: A delayed fallback
text: The transition `deliver` (priority 10) needs a `pending` request and a `reply`, while `fallback` (priority -10, `delayed(3000)`) needs only the request. A request with a reply is delivered at once; a request without one waits until `fallback` becomes ready three seconds after it was armed.

steps.text: At 0 ms both are armed, but `fallback` is not ready before 3000 ms, so `deliver` takes the first request and the reply. The place `pending` still holds a token in between, so `fallback` keeps its clock.
No second reply arrives. At 3000 ms `fallback` is ready and takes the second request.
